properties.description: EIA incremental controller. Reads the date watermark, probes source availability, creates no files and advances no watermark when zero rows are returned, and calls PL_EIA_ProcessData_INCREMENTAL only when data exists. Returns StartDate, EndDate, HasRows, and RowsFetched to the master.

activities.name: Lookup_Watermark
activities.description: Read last successful source date from control.PipelineWatermark.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT LastSuccessfulLoadDate FROM control.PipelineWatermark WHERE PipelineName = ''', pipeline().Pipeline, '''')

activities.name: Set_StartDate
activities.description: Use watermark + 1 day when available, first-run lookback otherwise, and clamp StartDate to TriggerDate to avoid StartDate > EndDate on same-day reruns.

activities.name: Set_BronzeFolderPath
activities.description: Create deterministic Bronze folder using extraction start/end dates.

activities.name: Get_EIAKey
activities.description: Fetch EIA API key from Key Vault.

activities.name: Get_EIATotal
activities.description: Probe EIA API to obtain total rows for extraction window.

activities.name: Check_DataAvailability
activities.description: If EIA returned rows, execute the child processing pipeline. If zero rows, do not create Parquet, do not load staging, and do not advance the data watermark.

activities.name: Set_PipelineReturnValue
activities.description: Return extraction window plus explicit HasRows/RowsFetched metadata to the master.

properties.description: ST37 controlled master orchestration. Industry-refactor v1: thin orchestration, ADF concurrency=1 plus existing SQL active-run guard, stage-produced row-count metadata propagation, and metadata-driven reconciliation. Master owns batch lifecycle; children own detailed stage failures. FINAL V2: thin-master ownership. Child pipelines own detailed stage failure logging; Master owns batch close/fail. Native Master failures use PL_Common_Error_Handler. Upstream row counts are propagated to reconciliation without ADLS recounts. FINAL V4: removed invalid nested IfCondition; uses a top-level Switch router after Bronze metadata is cached in pipeline variables. FINAL V6: PipelineControl close calls now explicitly set DataLoadStatus and ErrorCode. Canonicalized ExecutePipeline parameters for PL_Common_Error_Handler; null-safe ParentRunId; resilient failure-handler dependency where applicable.
